context.body: Resist, overcome, and destroy · Satan or the devil is named · 1 Peter 5:6–11
context.label: Resist, overcome, and destroy

observations.body: Peter calls for humility under God’s hand and for casting anxiety on him. He also calls for clear thinking and watchfulness because the devil prowls like a roaring lion. Readers must resist him in faith amid shared suffering. God will restore and strengthen them, and dominion belongs to him.
observations.label: The adversary prowls like a lion and is resisted in faith
